user_goal: Implement one role-responsive employee knowledge crew and its primary non-technical local dashboard.

cag_core_refs.purpose: public safety, retrieval, coordination, and approval rules
canonical role responsibility and capability ceilings
current admission profile and canonical state projection

facts: The public repository already has one unified Knowledge Case Controller and twenty-one bounded roles.
The committed dashboard is browser-local and provider-disabled but still foregrounds legacy workflow concepts.
The isolated TurboVec trial is promising but too small for default or production claims.
The owner explicitly authorized public dashboard implementation, documentation, visuals, validation, and Git push.
interpretations: The dashboard should project one case and role mission rather than expose frameworks as competing products.
Whole-project perception should mean stable context plus bounded retrieval, exact reads, and compact source-visible summaries, not loading every source into every prompt.
hypotheses: A mission-first default with optional trace and setup views will reduce employee orientation time while preserving evidence visibility.
gaps: No real employee pilot proves onboarding outcomes.
No production-scale TurboVec benchmark or private-corpus authorization exists.
The public dashboard has no durable multi-user state or authenticated local bridge.

memory_write_basis.wiki/memory.md: Records the corrected reusable constraint that role/state projections and framework evidence must remain synchronized across active contracts.
memory_write_basis.wiki/insights.md: Records reusable analytical meaning about one-case role projection and bounded whole-project perception; it excludes raw traces and private source text.

role_assignment.scope: read-only canonical admission role and state mapping

role_assignment.output: schema and dashboard projection applied by Maksym

acceptance_criteria: One case spine and role-responsive workflow replace Architecture 1 and Architecture 2.
Tool jobs and parameters are explicit and non-overlapping.
Four labeled source-controlled visuals are integrated.
The dashboard is the responsive non-technical local interface.
Provider-disabled system, browser, accessibility, and safety checks pass.
An independent reviewer approves or records exact remaining gaps.
evidence_required: official framework documentation for current technical behavior
desktop, tablet, and mobile visual readback
validation_checks: dashboard JavaScript syntax and route smoke
stop_conditions: private or secret data would enter public Git
a framework is presented as business authority
TurboVec would become the sole route without promotion proof
maker and reviewer are the same
deployment, provider execution, or external writeback becomes necessary
review_gate: Halyna iteration-four independent review after exact CrewAI and API binding projection is frozen
